# Feature request

## Problem

Describe the problem or limitation you are trying to solve. Explain who is
affected and why the current behavior is insufficient. Do not describe a
solution yet.

## Proposed solution

Describe the behavior you would like to see. Keep the closed option set, the
create-only contract and the dry-run guarantee in mind.

## Alternatives considered

Describe the other approaches you considered and why you rejected them. Include
workarounds you already tried, if any.

## Additional context

Add mockups, examples, links or any other context that helps evaluate the
request.
